title: Design: All tab with Status Closed lists closed internal work orders
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have one closed internal work order and one invoiced billable work order, made for this test.
  • Open the attached pictures iwo-flow1-23-09-work-orders-list-all-tab-status-closed.png, iwo-happy-19-19-work-orders-list-status-closed.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders.
  2. Click the All tab.
  3. Pick Closed in the Status chip.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The list opens.

Step 2:

  • Both work orders are in the list.

Step 3:

  • Only the closed internal work order is listed, with the status Closed, its Internal badge and "No Charge" in Total Price.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close)

  • S2-R10: “The Status chip on the All tab gets the value "Closed", which matches only closed internal and no-charge work orders; Invoiced and Paid do not match them.”
